setlist.title: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (3 reviews): The space following The Other One is described as wonderfully spooky and the reviewer's favorite part; The Other One is a ripping version, one the reviewer reaches for first [5][6][14]
- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): Reviewer says Jerry sounds totally dialed in on Eyes of the World; Eyes of the World is top-notch, with Jerry on fire [4][6][12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Cat into Rider is called sweet; After an uneventful opening, China Cat into Rider lifts the first set [5][8]
- **He's Gone** (2 reviews): He's Gone through Truckin' and The Other One into a jam runs about 45 minutes, quietly sliding into Me and Bobby McGee; He's Gone is outstanding, with Jerry in fine form and a soulful coda on the closing line [4][12]
- **The Race Is On** (1 review): The cowboy songs get extra flair in the first set, notably The Race Is On [13]
- **Big River** (1 review): Big River and Row Jimmy are described as near perfect [8]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Jerry plays in fine form on Row Jimmy [12]
- **Me and Bobby McGee** (1 review): Me and Bobby McGee is a standout in the second set [13]

## The recordings

- **gd73-11-23.sbd.orf.194.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 202 min; rated 4.07/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: The soundboard sounds fine, as expected; Vocals are clear and up front, unlike many 1973 recordings that sound muffled; Donna's voice is prominent in the mix, which this reviewer dislikes [5][7]
- **gd1973-11-23.sbd.orf.clevenger.6702.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 195 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Keith is barely audible on this tape, according to the reviewer; Keith is prominently featured in the mix, audible for instance on Don't Ease Me In [14][15]
- **gd1973-11-23.sbd.miller.112801.flac16**: soundboard; 26 songs; 202 min; rated 4.4/5 by 10 [3]

## Around the show

- The first set ran 17 songs and lasted just under two hours [4]
- Reviewer calls it underrated and one of the best shows of the tour [6]
- Reviewer says this 1973 show has not circulated widely and is underrated [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-11-23.sbd.orf.194.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Lineage: soundboard to reel to cassette to two DAT generations to CDR, via L. Orf; A reel flip occurs in the first track of disc one [1]
- **gd1973-11-23.sbd.orf.clevenger.6702.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > Reel > Cassette > Datx2 > CDR [2]. Also: Reel flips occur during Loser and Truckin'; there is also a glitch; Track cuts fall on sector boundaries, and editing was done with DART Pro 98 [2]
- **gd1973-11-23.sbd.miller.112801.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Reel Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [3]
